source_text: If a structural member spans a hull-area boundary, the largest hull area factor is used in scantling determination.
comparison_model: (ii) In the event that a structural member spans across the boundary of a hull area, the largest hull area factor is to be used in the scantling determination of the member.
oracle: For each represented structuralMember, selectedHullAreaFactor must equal the maximum hullAreaFactor among all hasSpannedHullArea values.

r13_contract.comparisonModel: (ii) In the event that a structural member spans across the boundary of a hull area, the largest hull area factor is to be used in the scantling determination of the member.
